senses.gloss:
शिफ शिफ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. शी),
= शिफा below, which is the more usual form; (आ),
f. a fibrous root or root in general; the root of a
water-lily; a lash or stroke with a whip; spikenard
(= मांसिका); turmeric; a sort of dill or fennel (=
शत-पुष्पा); a mother; a river; a particular
river (Ved.).
—शिफा-कन्द, अस्, अम्, m. n. the
root of a water-lily.
—शिफा-धर, अस्, m. ‘pos-
sessing a fibrous root,’ a branch.
—शिफा-रुह, अस्,
m. ‘root-growing,’ the Indian fig-tree; [cf. न्यग्-
रोध.]
शिफाक, अस्, m. the root of a water-lily.

शीफालिका शीफालिका, f. the plant Nyctan-
thes Tristis, (also written शेफालि, शेफालिका.)
